news.title: New Settings Out Now
news.text: The website now has a Settings panel.
news.article: Settings are live. Click the gear icon at the top to change the volume, switch animations between Full, Safe and Off, and pick a colour theme that re-colours the whole site. You can also change the layout: row spacing, list width, columns and text size. Your choices are saved on your device.

news.title: Diamond Tiertagger Update
news.text: A new version of the DiamondTier Tags mod is out.
news.article: The DiamondTier Tags mod has been updated. Your gamemode icon and tier now show inside the name tag, like (icon) LT2 | Name, and staff get the DiamondTier hammer badge above their head. It also loads faster by remembering the last tier list. Update it on CurseForge.

news.title: 1000+ Members In The Discord!!
news.article: The DiamondTier Discord now has over 1000 members. Thank you to everyone who joined and helped the community grow!
